passages.context: Question 30 article 4 and especially reply 3, Corpus Thomisticum paragraph [40257], were inspected in the exact response. Aquinas distinguishes assimilation to God by charity's affective union from assimilation by mercy's likeness of operation; the reply therefore qualifies rather than simply repeats the article's account of mercy.
passages.notes: The full article [40250]-[40257] supplies the argumentative context; the registered locus is the exact reply used by the Tenth Sunday guide.
